title: Config.Changed
description: The payload of one config change (topic troupe.core.config.aggregate:Config.Changed): every value one command changed, and every config file it wrote or removed. One command records exactly one. Field names are as recorded.

changes.description: Each value the command changed, at most once each. A change that would change nothing isn't recorded.

files.description: Each config file the change wrote or removed, so troupe can tell its own files from a person's.

entry.title: Change entry
entry.description: One value's change. A missing before means the value didn't exist; a missing after means it was removed. An entry for a group (an object) only ever removes it.

path.description: The value's logical path, as keys from the top of config, such as ["actors", "tester", "runner"].

before.description: The SHA-256 of the old value's canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces, UTF-8), the same form event ids hash. For a group, the hash of the whole group.

after.description: The new value. Never an object: an object is a group of values, each changed by its own entry.

value.title: Value
value.description: A config value: a string, number, boolean or list. A list's items may be any JSON value but null.

file.title: File written
file.description: A config file, relative to .troupe/, and the hash of the bytes troupe wrote. A missing hash means the change removed it.

path.description: The file, relative to the theatre's .troupe/ directory, with / separators.

hash.description: The SHA-256 of the file's bytes as troupe wrote them.
